Write a values file

Source: R/values.R
weft_values_write.Rd

weft_values_write() writes the values it is given to a JSON file in the form of a weft-values block (schema 1), for a document to read with a weft-values block that names the file. It works outside a knit, and in a targets pipeline. The arguments are those of weft_put(): named values, or names of variables, and calls of claim().

Usage

weft_values_write(path, ...)

Arguments

path

The file to write. A relative path is relative to the working directory.

...

Named values, as for weft_put().

Value

path, invisibly.

Details

The file is written atomically, as UTF-8 with \\n line ends. Nothing is written when an argument is refused, and the old file stays.

See also

weft_put()

Examples

f <- tempfile(fileext = ".json")
weft_values_write(f, n = 12L, site = "north")
cat(readLines(f), sep = "\n")
#> {"weft":1,"lang":"r","run":null,"at":1794619614,"values":{"n":{"t":"int","v":"12"},"site":{"t":"string","v":"north"}}}
